name: hrms
description: Enterprise multi-tenant Human Resource Management System. Helper scripts only: backend/ and frontend/ are independent npm projects with their own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:e2e:frontend: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e
